// ow-workshop debug build
settings
{
	main
	{
		Mode Name: "Zombie Survival"
		Description: "Survive waves of zombies"
	}
	modes
	{
		Team Deathmatch
		{
			enabled maps
			{
				Workshop Chamber
			}
		}
	}
}

variables {
    global:
        0: wave
        1: state
        2: spawn_points
        3: spawn_index
    player:
        0: score
        1: lives
}

subroutines {
    0: spawn_wave
}

rule ("Initialize player variables") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Each Player;
        All;
        All;
    }
    actions {
        Set Player Variable(Event Player, lives, 3);
    }
}

rule ("Debug: globals") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Global;
    }
    actions {
        Create HUD Text(All Players(All Teams), Custom String("debug build"), Null, Null, Right, -2000, Color(Orange), Null, Null, Visible To Sort Order and String, Default Visibility);
        Create HUD Text(All Players(All Teams), Null, Null, Custom String("wave: {0}", Global.wave), Right, -1000, Null, Null, Color(Orange), Visible To Sort Order and String, Default Visibility);
        Create HUD Text(All Players(All Teams), Null, Null, Custom String("state: {0}", Value In Array(Array(Custom String("Lobby"), Custom String("Playing"), Custom String("Over")), Global.state)), Right, -999, Null, Null, Color(Orange), Visible To Sort Order and String, Default Visibility);
        Create HUD Text(All Players(All Teams), Null, Null, Custom String("spawn_points: {0}", Mapped Array(Mapped Array(Array(Mapped Array(Global.spawn_points, If-Then-Else(Or(Compare(Count Of(Current Array Element), ==, 1), And(Not(Current Array Element), Compare(Current Array Element, !=, Null))), Custom String("[{0}]", Current Array Element), If-Then-Else(Count Of(Current Array Element), Custom String("[{0}, …+{1}]", Current Array Element, Subtract(Count Of(Current Array Element), 1)), Current Array Element)))), Append To Array(Append To Array(Or(Count Of(Current Array Element), And(Not(Current Array Element), Compare(Current Array Element, !=, Null))), If-Then-Else(And(Not(Count Of(Current Array Element)), Compare(Current Array Element, !=, Empty Array)), 3, Multiply(Count Of(Current Array Element), 3))), Current Array Element)), If-Then-Else(First Of(Current Array Element), Custom String("[{0}{1}]", String Replace(Custom String("{0}, {1}, {2}", Value In Array(Current Array Element, 2), Value In Array(Current Array Element, 3), Custom String("{0}, {1}, {2}", Value In Array(Current Array Element, 4), Value In Array(Current Array Element, 5), Custom String("{0}, {1}, …", Value In Array(Current Array Element, 6), Value In Array(Current Array Element, 7)))), String Slice(Custom String("0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, …"), Add(-2, Value In Array(Current Array Element, 1)), Subtract(22, Value In Array(Current Array Element, 1))), Empty Array), If-Then-Else(Compare(Value In Array(Current Array Element, 1), >, 18), Custom String("+{0}", Subtract(Divide(Value In Array(Current Array Element, 1), 3), 6)), Empty Array)), String Split(Value In Array(Current Array Element, 2), Empty Array)))), Right, -998, Null, Null, Color(Orange), Visible To Sort Order and String, Default Visibility);
        Create HUD Text(All Players(All Teams), Null, Null, Custom String("spawn_index: {0}", Global.spawn_index), Right, -997, Null, Null, Color(Orange), Visible To Sort Order and String, Default Visibility);
    }
}

rule ("Debug: players") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Each Player;
        All;
        All;
    }
    actions {
        Create HUD Text(Event Player, Custom String("debug build"), Null, Null, Right, -2000, Color(Sky Blue), Null, Null, Visible To Sort Order and String, Default Visibility);
        Create HUD Text(Event Player, Null, Null, Custom String("score: {0}", (Event Player).score), Right, -500, Null, Null, Color(Sky Blue), Visible To Sort Order and String, Default Visibility);
        Create HUD Text(Event Player, Null, Null, Custom String("lives: {0}", (Event Player).lives), Right, -499, Null, Null, Color(Sky Blue), Visible To Sort Order and String, Default Visibility);
    }
}

rule ("[Setup] Collect spawn points") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Global;
    }
    actions {
        Disable Inspector Recording;
        Set Global Variable(spawn_points, Spawn Points(Team 2));
        Set Global Variable(state, 0);
    }
}

rule ("[Setup] Start when players are in") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Global;
    }
    conditions {
        Global.state == False;
        Number Of Players(All Teams) >= 1;
    }
    actions {
        Wait(5, Ignore Condition);
        Set Global Variable(state, 1);
        If(True);
            Skip(Value In Array(Array(4, 0, 2), Add(1, Index Of Array Value(Array(1, 2), Global.state))));
            //label_1:
            Big Message(All Players(All Teams), Custom String("Survive!"));
        Else;
            //label_2:
            Big Message(All Players(All Teams), Custom String("Game over"));
        Else;
            //label_0:
        End;
    }
}

rule ("[Waves] Subroutine spawn_wave") {
    event {
        Subroutine;
        spawn_wave;
    }
    actions {
        Modify Global Variable(wave, Add, 1);
        For Global Variable(spawn_index, 0, Min(Count Of(Global.spawn_points), Add(Global.wave, 3)), 1);
            Create Dummy Bot(Hero(Reaper), Team 2, Global.spawn_index, Value In Array(Global.spawn_points, Global.spawn_index), Vector(0, 0, 0));
        End;
    }
}

rule ("[Waves] Run the waves") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Global;
    }
    conditions {
        Global.state == 1;
    }
    actions {
        While(Compare(Global.wave, <, 5));
            Call Subroutine(spawn_wave);
            Wait Until(Not(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), Compare(Team Of(Current Array Element), ==, Team 2)))), 120);
            Wait(5, Ignore Condition);
        End;
        Set Global Variable(state, 2);
        If(True);
            Skip(Value In Array(Array(4, 0, 2), Add(1, Index Of Array Value(Array(1, 2), Global.state))));
            //label_4:
            Big Message(All Players(All Teams), Custom String("Survive!"));
        Else;
            //label_5:
            Big Message(All Players(All Teams), Custom String("Game over"));
        Else;
            //label_3:
        End;
    }
}

rule ("[Players] Score on kill") {
    event {
        Player Died;
        All;
        All;
    }
    conditions {
        Attacker != Victim;
        Team Of(Victim) == Team 2;
    }
    actions {
        Modify Player Variable(Attacker, score, Add, 100);
    }
}

rule ("[Players] Lose a life") {
    event {
        Player Died;
        All;
        All;
    }
    conditions {
        Team Of(Victim) == Team 1;
    }
    actions {
        Modify Player Variable(Victim, lives, Add, -1);
        If(Compare((Victim).lives, <=, 0));
            Disable Built-In Game Mode Respawning(Victim);
    }
}

rule ("[HUD] Wave counter") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Global;
    }
    actions {
        Create HUD Text(All Players(All Teams), Custom String("Wave {0}", Global.wave), Null, Null, Left, 0, Color(White), Null, Null, Visible To Sort Order String and Color, Default Visibility);
        Create HUD Text(All Players(All Teams), Null, Custom String("{0} survivors", Number Of Living Players(All Teams)), Null, Left, 0, Null, Color(White), Null, Visible To Sort Order String and Color, Default Visibility);
    }
}

rule ("[HUD] Leaderboard") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Global;
    }
    actions {
        Create HUD Text(All Players(All Teams), Null, Null, Custom String("Leader: {0}", First Of(Sorted Array(Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), Compare(Team Of(Current Array Element), ==, Team 1)), Multiply(-1, (Current Array Element).score)))), Left, 0, Null, Null, Color(White), Visible To Sort Order String and Color, Default Visibility);
    }
}
